name: extraction-accuracy
description: Rubric for data/document extraction tasks — did the model pull the right fields, completely, in the requested format, without inventing values?

content.summary: Score the extraction output on field-level accuracy, completeness against the source document, output-format compliance, and absence of hallucinated values.

dimensions.name: extraction_accuracy
dimensions.title: Extraction accuracy
dimensions.description: Are the extracted values correct against the source? Every populated field must match the document verbatim or as the task's normalization rules allow.

dimensions.name: field_coverage
dimensions.title: Field coverage
dimensions.description: Is every field the task asked for present in the output? Missing or silently dropped fields score lower than explicit null/empty markers when the task permits them.

dimensions.name: format_compliance
dimensions.title: Format compliance
dimensions.description: Does the output follow the requested schema/format (JSON keys, types, array shapes, date/number formats, ordering)? Structure violations count here, not under accuracy.

dimensions.name: no_hallucination
dimensions.title: No hallucination
dimensions.description: Are all output values grounded in the source? Invented, guessed, or transposed values score near zero on this dimension even when the format is perfect.

criteria.text: Example criterion — the generator replaces these with task-specific checkable items (one per requested field or format rule).
